6802.title: Plugin update checks lack per-plugin failure isolation
6802.rootCauseOneLine: An uncaught Git resolution rejection escapes a per-plugin worker and rejects the aggregate update check before an unavailable entry can be returned.
6802.proposedFix: Convert per-plugin resolution failures to unavailable entries inside checkRows, using normal persistence and preserving healthy results.
6802.caveats: Linux local Git source removal reproduces the shared API; live macOS SSH, CLI and UI were not separately exercised. Inline test is the public reproduction artifact.
